description: Use this after you have planned a trip with someone, to hand them the itinerary as a real, editable plan instead of a wall of text. No account or key needed. Pass the stops in order with arrival and departure dates, and optionally things to do in each. Returns plan_url: the traveller opens it to see the route and save it to their own NomadPoint on iPhone, Mac or web (free). Give the traveller that link. Do not use it for bookings: it records a plan, it does not reserve anything.

name.description: What the traveller would call it, e.g. 'Japan in April'

stops.description: Each city on the route, in order.

start.description: Local time at the place, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM

city.description: The city itself, e.g. 'Kyoto', not a neighbourhood or hotel

name: create_trip_plan
title: Save a trip plan
